properties.retrospective:
## Performance Optimization Complete

### Results
- **Before:** fast_speedup=0.139x (7.2x slower than standard search)
- **After:** fast_speedup=34.082x (34x faster than standard search)
- **Improvement:** 245x better performance

### Root Cause Identified
O(n) document scan in fast_find_documents (lines 211-224) was iterating over ALL 1199 documents and tokenizing each document name per query.

### Fix Applied
1. Removed O(n) pre-scan loop
2. Kept _apply_document_name_boost for documents with content matches
3. Updated test to document intentional trade-off

### Trade-off
Pure name-only matches (no content match) are not included in fast search. Use standard find_documents_for_query for comprehensive search.

### Commit
e9c183a1 - perf(query): Remove O(n) document scan from fast_find_documents

### Scientific Method Followed
1. ✅ Established baseline first
2. ✅ Identified bottleneck with data
3. ✅ Formed hypothesis with predicted improvement
4. ✅ Made ONE change
5. ✅ Re-measured and verified
